column5: JSON_LENGTH now follows builtinJSONLengthSig for scalar roots, direct-child container counts, exact single-selection paths, NULL propagation, missing paths, and multiple-selection errors; JSON_MEMBER_OF, JSON_CONTAINS, JSON_CONTAINS_PATH, JSON_OVERLAPS, JSON_KEYS, and JSON_REMOVE now carry source-owned scalar/object/array value semantics, recursive containment, path existence and ONE/ALL short-circuiting, sorted object-key extraction, sequential exact-path removal, path extraction, NULL propagation, and invalid-document/path errors; JSON_ARRAY_APPEND and JSON_ARRAY_INSERT now preserve scalar SQL-value coercion, exact path traversal, root/scalar wrapping, sequential mutation, insertion shifting, out-of-range append, and invalid-path boundaries; JSON_SET, JSON_INSERT, and JSON_REPLACE now preserve exact sequential paths, scalar/NULL value coercion, root replacement, missing-member insertion, scalar array-leg wrapping, and invalid-path errors; JSON_MERGE and JSON_MERGE_PRESERVE now preserve adjacent-object recursive merge, array flattening, scalar wrapping, and NULL propagation; JSON_MERGE_PATCH now preserves RFC 7396 object recursion/deletion, non-object replacement, SQL NULL truncation, sorted keys, and invalid-document errors; JSON_PRETTY now preserves BinaryJSON sorted-key formatting, two-space nested indentation, scalar identity, NULL propagation, and invalid-document errors; JSON_SUM_CRC32 now preserves homogeneous scalar-array CRC32 summation, Go-style integer/ordinary-double text, empty-array/NULL/error behavior; typed BinaryJSON/FieldType conversion, explicit JSON path extraction, session warning state, function-class construction, and vectorized execution remain explicit boundaries
